---
title: "Projects"
---

Stable project pages for ongoing UWC ML Liaison work. Blog posts will provide
updates and reflections; these pages should remain relatively stable.

## Physical-Process MLWP Seminar Series

A seminar series focused on whether and how machine-learning weather prediction
models represent atmospheric processes. See [Seminar Series](seminar-series.qmd).

## Common MLWP Verification Tooling

Work towards reusable tooling for evaluating MLWP forecasts, including common
data structures, verification workflows, and process-aware diagnostics.

This work connects to the planned split of RMI-developed verification tooling
into focused packages such as data specifications, data loaders, and alignment /
verification components.

## Km-Scale MLWP Frontier / Review

Work to map the published state of the art for kilometre-scale MLWP, including
known strengths, limitations, physical consistency, uncertainty, and cloud /
precipitation behaviour.

## MLWP Data Sharing And Common Formats

Work towards shared forecast datasets, common object-store infrastructure, and
forecast data formats suitable for operational and scientific comparison across
centres.

## MLWP Ecosystem Map

A possible public-facing overview of software, models, datasets, and community
initiatives relevant to ML weather forecasting. Publication depends on whether
the material is durable and safe to share.
